en: The image shows a mid-century modern hotel building with several floors and balconies. There are a few cars parked in front of the hotel and several people walking on the driveway. The area is green with trees and landscaped gardens. The building has a sign in Cyrillic on the roof. The postcard reverse contains printed text in both Cyrillic and Latin, indicating location and hotel name, as well as a stamp mark and handwritten number.
